line.en: the free after-dark festival, 18:00 to 22:00 on capel street, with dame street and college green around it. the opener of winter in dublin.
line.de: das kostenlose fest nach dem dunkelwerden, 18 bis 22 uhr in der capel street, dame street und college green dazu. der auftakt von winter in dublin.
line.tr: karanlıktan sonra ücretsiz festival, capel street'te 18:00 ile 22:00 arası; dame street ve college green de dahil. winter in dublin'in açılışı.
